name: Ehsebha
summary: A clearer picture of the working day. An Arabic-first dashboard that brings trips, expenses, and driver earnings together.
description: Drivers work across several apps, but their real earnings depend on fuel, commission, and maintenance. Ehsebha brings those details into a bilingual web app, with a dashboard, trip management, vehicle costs, and a profit simulator. The frontend pairs React with TanStack Query and an installable PWA shell.
imageAlt: Ehsebha welcome page with driver earnings features and sign-in form.
previewNote: Captured from the public demo. Sign-in was unavailable during the September 2026 review; the linked source code shows the application features.
highlights: Arabic-first interface with English and RTL/LTR support
Trips, expenses, vehicle costs, and analytics in one workspace
Client-side profit simulator for exploring different working scenarios
Installable PWA with a separate administration app

name: Online Exam
summary: From choosing a subject to reviewing an answer. A focused exam experience built around progress, timing, and feedback.
description: An exam flow needs to keep students oriented while time is running. This Angular application connects diploma browsing, timed questions, saved answer progress, and a review screen. Authentication is separated into a reusable library, while lazy-loaded routes keep the feature structure clear.
imageAlt: Online Exam sign-in page captured from the Angular application running locally.
previewNote: Local capture of the public repository. The previously listed hosted demo was unavailable during review.
highlights: Timed questions with progress indicators and saved answers
Diploma browsing, exam navigation, and answer review
Reusable authentication library with typed request contracts
Standalone components, Signals, and lazy-loaded feature routes

name: Postify
summary: A small application with attention to the everyday details: finding a post, reading a discussion, and getting useful feedback.
description: Postify explores the full reading and writing flow around a posts API. Readers can search a responsive card grid, open a post, and browse comments. Angular Signal Forms handle validation, with loading skeletons, empty states, and toast feedback throughout. JSONPlaceholder simulates submissions, so new posts and comments are not persisted.
imageAlt: Postify interface captured from the Angular application running locally.
previewNote: Local capture of the public repository. JSONPlaceholder simulates submissions; new posts and comments are not persisted.
highlights: Live title search with signal-based filtering
Post details, comments, and validated submission forms
Loading skeletons, empty states, and clear request feedback
JSONPlaceholder demo API; submissions are simulated
